title: Coproducing Universal Credit disability benefits
intro: A participatory action research project with disabled people across England and Wales, exploring changes to the health element of Universal Credit.

blocks.heading: Led by lived experience
paragraphs: Peer researchers will co-design the study, gather insights and develop practical recommendations. The project aims to bring disabled people’s experience into policy decisions and help protect living standards.

blocks.heading: Our approach
paragraphs: Toynbee Hall’s participatory action research puts people affected by policy at the centre of the research and the solutions. Contact research@toynbeehall.org.uk to learn about the project.
